subject.title: Require explicit Keychain interaction for Chromium cookies

question: Should SweetCookieKit adopt `BrowserCookieKeychainAccessGate.withUserInteractionDisallowed` as the public long-term host API for background imports?
rationale: This is a new public interaction-policy contract around sensitive Keychain behavior, so its naming, scope, and compatibility semantics require repository-owner intent even after the mechanical fallback defect is fixed.

options.title: Adopt scoped policy
options.body: Keep default interactive recovery and accept the TaskLocal no-prompt scope after all noninteractive aliases are tried and live behavior is proven.

options.title: Use an import option
options.body: Replace the public gate with an explicit per-import policy parameter so interaction intent is visible at the call site.

options.title: Defer public API
options.body: Keep the existing released behavior and postpone background prompt suppression until the host contract is better defined.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped policy
recommendation.body: Keep default interactive recovery and accept the TaskLocal no-prompt scope after all noninteractive aliases are tried and live behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored and released the current Safe Storage lookup contract and is the best available owner for the repository-level public API decision.
